Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking a quick call last week — excited to explore a co-delivered "Embedded Solution Labs" series between Northbridge and Redwood. Attached is a short draft syllabus (proposed_syllabus.pdf) that sketches a 3-day lab curriculum for partner engineers, plus an outline of a lightweight certification path so consultancies can badge their consultants.

High level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a train-the-trainer (TTT) session so Northbridge and Maple trainers can run labs independently?
- What materials (labs, prompts, evals) can be white-labeled vs. require Redwood presence?
- Any constraints around demo accounts / customer data for hands-on exercises?

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Ellis Tran <ellis@northbridge.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 11:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded SI Labs — draft syllabus and certification concept

Ellis —

Great to see this coming together. Appreciate the syllabus — solid starting point. High-level response and proposed next steps below.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Train-the-trainer: Yes — we can run a 2-day TTT that covers lab facilitation, troubleshooting, and the evaluation rubric. We usually include a train-the-trainer kit (slides, instructor notes, sample student exercises).
- Materials: Most of the labs can be white-labeled for partner delivery. Anything that touches Redwood's internal telemetry / observability (tracing examples, cost dashboards) will need our presence or a sanitized view. We can provide sanitized demo tenants for hands-on work.
- Demo accounts / data: We provide ephemeral demo instances with synthetic data for public cohorts. For private/paid cohorts that need customer data, we require a short DPA addendum and an isolation plan (VPC demo or dedicated sandbox).

Proposed timeline / next steps:
1) Align scope: agree on a 3-day hands-on lab + 1-day certification practical exam.
2) Draft MOU + DPA addendum (we can circulate a template).
3) Redwood to deliver a 2-day TTT in late Oct / early Nov.
4) Cohort 1 labs in mid-November.

I've attached a quick TTT agenda (redwood-ttt-agenda.docx) for your review. If this matches, I'll loop legal and ops to start the MOU/DPA.

If you want, let's set a short call next week to finalize scope. I'm available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you both.

— Rishi
Head of Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Looping in a couple operational notes from the field ops and partnerships side:

- Capacity: Ops needs 3 weeks lead time to provision ephemeral demo tenants per cohort (we can do 5 concurrent sandboxes for a cohort). If you want a private customer sandbox, that requires additional review.
- Pricing & commercial: If Northbridge wants Redwood-delivered TTT + certification admin, we should discuss a per-seat fee plus a revenue share on certification badges. Marissa, can you draft commercial options?
- SLAs: For partner-run cohorts, we should define support windows — e.g., Redwood on-call during lab hours for any infra incidents.

Ellis — happy to take the pricing conversation. Also, please confirm whether your trainers will require admin-level access to the demo tenants or just instructor-level credentials.

Thanks,
Laura
Partner Programs Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi / Laura — this looks good. Per your questions:

- Trainers: Northbridge + Maple trainers will need instructor-level credentials. We only request admin access for a single sandbox for initial validation.
- Timeline: Oct TTT + Nov cohort 1 works for us.
- Commercial: we're open to a per-seat fee for Redwood admin + a modest revenue share on paid certification badges. Please have Marissa send options.

I've attached a preliminary MOU for review (draft_mou.docx). I've also shared a Drive folder with sample deliverables: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSI-LABS (we can move to Redwood Drive link later).
